## 🐛 Describe the bug **Setup:** DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (mxfp4 experts) on 4× H200 (SM90), TP=4, served from the official image `vllm/vllm-openai:deepseekv41-flash-0909` (vLLM `0.1.dev20904+g179dd0fa9`). ```bash vllm serve /models/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash \ --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \ --reasoning-parser deepseek_v41 \ --tool-call-parser deepseek_v41 \ --tensor-parallel-size 4 \ --enable-expert-parallel \ --max-model-len 262144 \ --max-num-batched-tokens 2048 \ --max-num-seqs 512 \ --block-size 64 \ --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \ --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 \ --moe-backend auto \ --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","custom_ops":["all"]}' \ --enable-auto-tool-choice \ --enable-chunked-prefill \ --enable-prefix-caching \ --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune \ --speculative-config '{"method": "dspark", "draft_sample_method": "greedy", "num_speculative_tokens": 5}' \ --trust-remote-code ``` **What happens:** engine init proceeds normally on SM90 — the mxfp4 MoE oracle correctly falls back from the SM100-only kernels to **`MARLIN`** (`Using 'MARLIN' Mxfp4 MoE backend.`), `MarlinMxfp8LinearKernel for MXFP8 GEMM` for the dense layers, `fp8_ds_mla` KV cache, weights load (118.69 GiB/GPU), engram token map is built: ```text INFO ... [engram.py:436] Built engram token map (129280 -> 99092 ids) for layers (1, 14) ``` KV cache allocates, CUDA graphs capture, then the DSpark draft warmup crashes all workers ~35 s after load completes: ```text (Worker_TP0_EP0 pid=758) ERROR ... [multiproc_executor.py:1055] File "/usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/dspark/speculator.py", line 265, in _generate_draft (Worker_TP0_EP0 pid=758) ERROR ... self._sample_sequential(num_reqs, head_hidden) (Worker_TP0_EP0 pid=758) ERROR ... [multiproc_executor.py:1055] File "/usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/dspark/speculator.py", line 183, in _sample_sequential (Worker_TP0_EP0 pid=758) ERROR ... draft_sampled_i = self._sample_logits( (Worker_TP0_EP0 pid=758) ERROR ... [multiproc_executor.py:1055] File "/usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/dspark/speculator.py", line 128, in _sample_logits (Worker_TP0_EP0 pid=758) ERROR ... return self.model.map_draft_to_target(logits.argmax(dim=-1)) (Worker_TP0_EP0 pid=758) ERROR ... torch.AcceleratorError: CUDA error: device-side assert triggered ... (EngineCore pid=421) ERROR ... [multiproc_executor.py:314] Worker proc VllmWorker-3 died unexpectedly (exit code: None), shutting down executor. (EngineCore pid=421) RuntimeError: Worker failed with error 'CUDA error: device-side assert triggered Search for `cudaErrorAssert' in https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-runtime-api/group__CUDART__TYPES.html for more information.' (APIServer pid=76) RuntimeError: Engine core initialization failed. See root cause above. ``` A device-side assert inside `map_draft_to_target(...)` looks like an out-of-range index in the draft→target vocab mapping (engram token map), i.e. the DSpark drafter may not be compatible with the Marlin mxfp4 SM90 path (the MoE oracle itself notes `TRITON_UNFUSED has bug with MTP support` — mxfp4 + spec decode combos seem fragile on pre-Blackwell). **Workaround:** removing `--speculative-config` lets the model serve correctly on Marlin (init completes, `/v1/models` OK, ~15x concurrency at 256K context). **Expected:** DSpark speculative decoding should either work on SM90 with the Marlin mxfp4 fallback, or fail fast with a clear "not supported on this backend/architecture" error at config validation time instead of a device-side assert after a ~15-minute weight load. **Related issues:** #52065 (DSpark fails to start on H100 sm90, different kernel), #54011 (DSpark on H20/SM90), #54179 (DSV4-Flash + DSpark assertion on H20), #56389 (DSV4.1-Flash on H20), #50576 (feature: SM8x DSpark support), #41834 (SM12x support). Happy to rerun with `VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL=DEBUG` / `VLLM_TRACE_FUNCTION=1` and/or `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` to pin the exact indexing op if that helps. ## Before submitting a new issue... - [x] Searched existing issues (list above); docs chatbot consulted.
